content:
mai: short proposal: split internal error taxonomy from what we show users. introduce `exposure_level` with values internal, badge, visible.
raul: ok. what's the rule to flip from internal->badge?
mai: gate: either manual sign-off OR metric-driven: >5000 hits in 24h AND rate >=0.05%
jena: telemetry: add tag `exposure_level` and `route_shard` so we can track cost/regressions.
owen: console: badge should be subtle: gray pill "degraded (fallback)". visible = red with docs link and suggested model.
mai: SDKs: expose a `client_hint` string and convenience `isVisible()` helper. also add header `X-RI-Exposure: badge` for old clients.
raul: rollback rule? auto revert if false-positive >0.75% in 24h. page oncall then.
jena: I'll build a lightweight "Exposure rollup" dashboard: promotions, false-positives, token cost delta.
owen: add per-org toggle to force `visible` for specific codes (audit log required).
incidents-bot: created ticket RI-EXP-2042 and feature-flag `exposure_gate` = off.
mai: action items: runtime add fields + header (default internal), platform add badges+toggles, devx add SDK helper, telemetry add tags+dashboard.
raul: +1. schedule runtime change in next deploy window; canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%.
mai: thanks — follow-up Friday for canary check-in.
